title: 6 What is the right and lawfull vſe of Baptiſme.

segments.text: THE right and lawfull vſe of baptiſme is, when the ceremonies or rites inſtituted by Chriſt in baptiſme are not changed. Whence it is manifeſt, that the droſſe and filth of Papiſts; as oile, ſpettle, and exorciſme or coniuration, is to bee throwen away. Obiection. But theſe appertaine and belong to order and comlineſſe. Aunſwere. The Holy Ghoſt knew well enough, what did appertain thereunto. Reply. But they appertaine to the ſignifieng of ſome thing. Anſ. It belongeth not to men, to Inſtitute any ſign of Gods wil. This alſo we are to thinke & iudge of others of the ſame hatching. 2. The vſe of baptiſme is right when baptiſm is giuen to them, for whom it was inſtituted, which are al the cōuerted, or mēbers of the church. 3. When baptiſme is vſed to that ende, whereunto it was inſtituted: not for the healing of cattle: but when the true endes thereof are reſpected. Briefly, the lawful and right vſe of Baptiſme is, when hee that is conuerted is baptized according to the lawfull rite and end. Now, Baptiſme may not be reiterated, 1 Becauſe it dependeth not on the perſon of him that baptizeth. And further he that is once engraffed into Chriſt ſhal neuer bee caſt out or reiected: and therefore it ſufficeth to be once receiued. 2 Saluation doth not depend on baptiſme.
